description: This file defines the AttendanceService class within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system, handling attendance-related business logic such as creating, checking, and updating attendance records, managing user permissions, and configuring workflow states for attendance operations.

classes.name: AttendanceService
classes.description: Main service class handling attendance operations such as record management, permission checks, and workflow configuration, utilizing traits for authentication and user role management.

methods.name: getAccessFlowStateMachineService
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns an instance of AccessFlowStateMachineService.

methods.name: getAttendanceDao
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns an instance of AttendanceDao.

methods.name: setAttendanceDao
methods.description: Sets the AttendanceDao instance, allowing dependency injection.

methods.name: canUserChangeCurrentTime
methods.description: Checks if the current user is authorized to change the current time.

methods.name: savePunchRecord
methods.description: Persists an attendance punch record.

methods.name: checkForPunchOutOverLappingRecords
methods.description: Checks for overlapping punch-out records for an employee between specified times.

methods.name: checkForPunchInOverLappingRecords
methods.description: Checks for overlapping punch-in records for an employee.

methods.name: getAttendanceRecord
methods.description: Retrieves attendance records for a specific employee on a given date.

methods.name: deleteAttendanceRecords
methods.description: Deletes attendance records by ID.

methods.name: getAttendanceRecordById
methods.description: Retrieves an attendance record by its ID.

methods.name: getTimezone
methods.description: Returns timezone name from an offset value.

methods.name: getTimezoneArray
methods.description: Provides an array of timezone offsets mapped to timezone names.

methods.name: getLocalTimezone
methods.description: Determines timezone name based on a client offset.

methods.name: checkForPunchInOverLappingRecordsWhenEditing
methods.description: Checks for overlapping punch-in records during editing.

methods.name: checkForPunchOutOverLappingRecordsWhenEditing
methods.description: Checks for overlapping punch-out records during editing.

methods.name: checkForPunchInOutOverLappingRecordsWhenEditing
methods.description: Checks for overlapping punch-in/out records during editing.

methods.name: searchAttendanceRecords
methods.description: Searches attendance records based on various filters.

methods.name: getLatestPunchInRecord
methods.description: Retrieves the latest punch-in record for an employee and state.

methods.name: getPunchTimeUserConfiguration
methods.description: Checks if user has configuration to edit punch time.

methods.name: getAttendanceRecordsBetweenTwoDays
methods.description: Fetches attendance records within a date range for an employee.

methods.name: getAttendanceRecordsByEmpNumbers
methods.description: Retrieves attendance records for multiple employee numbers.

methods.name: canUserChangeCurrentTimeConfiguration
methods.description: Checks if user can change current time configuration.

methods.name: canUserModifyAttendanceConfiguration
methods.description: Checks if user can modify attendance records.

methods.name: canSupervisorModifyAttendanceConfiguration
methods.description: Checks if supervisor can modify attendance records.

methods.name: enableUserCanChangeCurrentTimeConfiguration
methods.description: Enables configuration allowing user to change current time.

methods.name: disableUserCanChangeCurrentTimeConfiguration
methods.description: Disables the user’s ability to change current time.

methods.name: enableUserCanModifyAttendanceConfiguration
methods.description: Enables modification of attendance records for user.

methods.name: disableUserCanModifyAttendanceConfiguration
methods.description: Disables user's ability to modify attendance records.

methods.name: enableSupervisorCanModifyAttendanceConfiguration
methods.description: Allows supervisors to modify attendance configurations.

methods.name: disableSupervisorCanModifyAttendanceConfiguration
methods.description: Disables supervisor modifications of attendance.

methods.name: saveConfiguration
methods.description: Saves a specific workflow state machine configuration record.

methods.name: isAuthUserAllowedToPerformTheEditActions
methods.description: Checks if the logged-in user is authorized to perform edit actions on an attendance record.
